name: GIRDER 格拉德 Jaunt carbon gravel SRAM Apex AXS
why_interesting: GIRDER's carbon gravel bike: a T700 + T800 press-fit frame with SRAM Apex AXS 1×12 and 45C tires at a 9.7 kg claim; the official page leaves the price blank.

facts.drivetrain: SRAM Apex AXS electronic 1×12; KUGGIS integrated CNC 44T chainring (crank arms not specified), 11-44T cassette (brand not stated); chain not listed
facts.frame: ROAD-section JAUNT T700 + T800 carbon gravel frame and fork, 12 mm thru-axles, fully internal routing
facts.frame_material: T700 + T800 carbon frame and fork; fiber supplier and lay-up are not published
facts.frame_construction: EPS-molded gravel frame and fork with internal routing and press-fit bottom bracket
facts.stiffness_evidence: No measured or comparative stiffness evidence found
facts.bottom_bracket: Press-fit shell per manufacturer; the supplied in-house ceramic-bearing BB (19 G5 silicon-nitride balls) has no standard named, so confirm the shell before ordering parts
facts.wheels: Alloy double-wall rims, four-bearing thru-axle hubs
facts.tires: Maxxis 700C×45C folding tires fitted; maximum clearance is not published
facts.cockpit: Gravel-specific integrated carbon handlebar with internal routing, 12° flare
facts.saddle: Selle Italia saddle and silicone bar tape
facts.sizes: 490 mm, 520 mm; the size dimension is not labelled
facts.complete_weight_basis: Manufacturer-listed weight for this complete bike; size, pedals and weighing method are not stated
